notes: Sourced directly from the official Arturia PolyBrute User Manual (v1.0, downloads.arturia.net), which includes a labeled rear-panel diagram, a connections table, and a Specifications chapter confirming exact jack types (Master Out and Sustain = TS/unbalanced, Expression pedals and Sync = TRS) and AC input ratings. This is the original 6-voice PolyBrute (2020); the newer PolyBrute 12 variant has different/additional I/O and is not covered here. Memory Protection is a rear-panel On/Off switch, not a signal or power connector, so it is omitted from the port list. USB grade omitted because the manual does not state a USB speed/version (port is used for MIDI + editor/firmware data only, not audio). Master Out and Sustain jacks are confirmed as 1/4" TS (mono/unbalanced) rather than TRS per the Specifications table's "Jack: Mono TS" entry.

ports.name: Master Out Right
ports.note: Unbalanced +4dBu line-level output; used alone for mono summing.

ports.name: Master Out Left
ports.note: Unbalanced +4dBu line-level output; carries mono sum when only this output is used.

ports.name: Sync In
ports.note: 3.5mm analog clock/gate input, 0-5V, for syncing non-MIDI modular/eurorack gear.

ports.name: Expression 1
ports.note: 1/4" TRS expression pedal input (tip = pot wiper, ring = 3.3V, sleeve = ground); pedal sold separately.

ports.name: Expression 2
ports.note: 1/4" TRS expression pedal input; pedal sold separately.

ports.name: Sustain
ports.note: 1/4" normally-open sustain pedal input, selectable polarity; pedal sold separately.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: USB Type B; carries MIDI and PolyBrute Editor/firmware traffic only, no audio streaming. Cable recommended ≤10m/3m.

ports.name: Power
ports.note: IEC AC inlet with on/off switch; auto-switching 100-240V AC, 50-60Hz, 85W, internal PSU (no external adapter).

ports.name: Headphone
ports.note: Front-panel stereo headphone jack with independent level control.
